resources.string: Checks run one after another and use the GitHub API without signing in (60 requests per hour, shared by all apps on your network).

Add any public GitHub repository. RepoShelf identifies it, checks its releases and whether it contains an installable Android package. You decide whether to install the app or only follow its releases.
